verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that Figma has components and library component instances used across files. Those can be published across teams, which implies reusable components with linked instances. However, nothing in the pack documents variants or per-instance overrides, and nothing describes how instances stay linked to their source. missing for 10: documented variants, documented per-instance overrides, explicit instance-to-main-component linking/propagation behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source

citations.quote: Get summary information about how many instances of a library's components exist across all files.
